newsitem.title: JAPAN: Key JGB futures down a touch in thin Friday trade.
newsitem.headline: Key JGB futures down a touch in thin Friday trade.

text.p: Key December Japanese government bond futures ended a little lower on Friday, having hardly strayed from their Thursday closing level throughout the session.
Many market players were reluctant to take new positions ahead of the weekend and the release of August industrial output data on Monday next week.

After opening lower, following a bearish market in London, the December regained the 122 level at one point. But few dealers were eager to take it up from there, after technical charts turned negative following Thursday's fall, dealers said.
